procedure.name: Open a small food outlet
procedure.summary: Everything needed to legally open and operate a small food outlet (restaurant, cafe, or food stall) in Mumbai.

steps.title: PAN Card Application
steps.description: Apply for a Permanent Account Number, required as identity/tax proof for nearly every later step.
steps.issuingOffice: Protean eGov Technologies (authorized by Income Tax Dept.)
steps.feeNote: ₹91 + GST for Indian communication address; ₹862 + GST if the communication address is outside India. Confirmed on the official Income Tax Dept. page.
steps.notes: min processing day estimate is not stated on the official page and needs confirmation; max (15) matches the fast-track figure quoted across sources.

steps.title: Rent Agreement + NOC from property owner
steps.description: Execute a registered rent agreement for the business premises and obtain a No-Objection Certificate from the property owner for commercial use.
steps.feeNote: UNVERIFIED — stamp duty and registration fees depend on rent amount/lease term and must be confirmed on the IGR Maharashtra e-registration portal, not left at 0 in the final version.
steps.notes: UNVERIFIED — homepage only confirmed reachable; the specific e-registration sub-page and fee schedule still need to be located and cited directly.

steps.title: Shop & Establishment registration (Gumasta)
steps.description: Register the business premises under the Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act via the Aaple Sarkar portal.
steps.feeNote: UNVERIFIED — third-party sources quote inconsistent figures (varies by employee count/registration type); must be confirmed live on Aaple Sarkar before this ships.
steps.notes: UNVERIFIED fee/processing figures — see PR notes. Structure and portal are confirmed.

steps.title: Udyam (MSME) Registration
steps.description: Register the business as a micro/small/medium enterprise on the Udyam portal using PAN and Aadhaar.
steps.feeNote: Udyam registration is free of cost on the official portal.
steps.notes: UNVERIFIED — fee (free) is widely and consistently stated but should still be confirmed by opening the live portal page directly and citing the specific sub-page.

steps.title: FSSAI Food Business Registration/License
steps.description: Register or license the food business with FSSAI via FoSCoS; the tier (registration vs. license) depends on turnover and scale.
steps.issuingOffice: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
steps.feeNote: UNVERIFIED — fee tiers depend on turnover/license type and must be pulled directly from the FoSCoS fee schedule page.
steps.notes: UNVERIFIED fee/exact tier — structure and dependency on Gumasta certificate still need a cited source page explaining why FSSAI requires proof of a registered premises.

steps.title: Open a Business Current Bank Account
steps.description: Open a current account in the business's name, using PAN, Udyam certificate, and Gumasta certificate as KYC/business proof.
steps.feeNote: Varies by bank; typically free to open, some require a minimum balance.
steps.notes: UNVERIFIED — sourceUrl is RBI's homepage as a placeholder; must be replaced with the specific KYC circular/master direction page that states current-account documentation requirements for businesses.

steps.title: GST Registration
steps.description: Register for Goods and Services Tax. Only required once annual turnover crosses the threshold for the applicant's entity type/state.
steps.department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
steps.feeNote: GST registration itself is free on the official portal.
steps.notes: UNVERIFIED — homepage only; needs a cited sub-page for the exact process/fee statement. Excluded from this demo journey by an applicabilityRule (turnover below ₹20 lakh threshold).

steps.title: Company Incorporation
steps.description: Incorporate as a Private Limited Company via the MCA's SPICe+ form. Only applicable if the applicant chooses to register as a company rather than a proprietorship/partnership/LLP.
steps.feeNote: UNVERIFIED — MCA fee schedule (SPICe+) depends on authorized capital and must be pulled directly from the MCA portal.
steps.notes: UNVERIFIED — homepage only; needs the specific SPICe+ page cited. Excluded from this demo journey by an applicabilityRule (entityType is not PRIVATE_LIMITED).

prerequisites.reason: Gumasta registration requires a copy of the applicant's PAN card as identity proof.
Gumasta registration requires proof of premises (rent agreement and owner's NOC).
Udyam registration requires the applicant's PAN number.
FSSAI registration requires the Gumasta certificate as proof of a legally registered business premises.
Opening a business current account requires the proprietor's/entity's PAN.
Banks require the Udyam registration certificate as business proof for a current account.
Banks require the Gumasta certificate as proof of a legally registered business for a current account.

applicabilityRules.exclusionReason: GST registration is not required because annual turnover is below the ₹20 lakh threshold.
Company incorporation is not required because the business is not being registered as a private limited company.
